Tribal girls set Guinness record with Dhimsa dance performance

Approximately 13,750 tribal schoolchildren participated in a Dhimsa dance performance at Bhogapuram airport. The event, described as a 'jamboree', aimed to highlight the tribal heritage of Andhra Pradesh. The performance successfully set a Guinness World Record. The event was part of the inaugural ceremony of the Bhogapuram airport.
